t: A quiet 32-bit control board that upgrades Ender 3 style 3D printers.
steps: Buy the board from BIQU or a 3D printing shop such as West3D for about 36 to 47 US dollars.
Unplug your printer and take photos of the old wiring.
Mount the new board in the Ender 3 case and move each cable across.
Install VS Code with the PlatformIO add-on on your computer.
Download Marlin 2.1 or newer. Set the board to SKR Mini E3 V3 in its config files.
Build the firmware and copy firmware.bin to a microSD card.
Insert the card, power the printer on, and wait for the update to finish.
Home each axis and print a small test cube.
meta: Open Board. From $35.95. A few stores.
